ShortDescription.Value: Select road nodes forming any perimeter and generate a perfect inner road grid.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Grid Road Generator
Select several existing road nodes (the corners of a perimeter — any polygon: rectangle, L-shape, rotated, irregular), then confirm to generate a perfect grid of inner roads, oriented on the perimeter's longest edge and clipped to its boundaries.
- Spacing, rows and columns configurable in Options > Mods - Uses the road prefab currently selected in the road tool (falls back to a small two-lane road)
